detailed_description:
Photoreal cinematic live-action, 1881 London, 35 mm film grain, natural weight and pace.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:04. The shot begins from <Picture 2>: a wide exterior, a wet cobbled street just off Piccadilly under a grey afternoon sky: a black two-wheeled hansom entering from the left at a trot, a bay horse in the shafts, the cabman up on his high seat behind the folding hood, the brass side-lamp at the corner, two hatted figures side by side under the hood; shopfronts, gas lamps lit early. The camera holds a static shot as the hansom enters at the left edge of frame and travels the whole width of the street at a trot, the horse advancing along the cobbles and the wheels turning, and leaves at the right edge of frame, from 00:00 to 00:02. At 00:02 its wheels throw water from a puddle as it passes the centre, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. Behind him four pedestrians under umbrellas on the far pavement about their own errands, a boy at the crossing with both hands on his broom handle, and a second hansom waiting at the far kerb, from 00:00 to 00:04.
[Shot 2] From 00:04 to 00:08. At 00:04 the shot cuts to an insert low beside the moving hansom, in the same street, beginning from <Picture 3>: the tall spoked wheel and the brass side-lamp, the horse's hind legs ahead of the wheel, rain-wet cobbles blurring beneath, spray flying; only what <Picture 3> shows is in frame. The camera is down on the wet cobbles at the near kerb, the lens at the height of the near wheel's hub, a forearm's length above the stones. At the first frame The one tall spoked wheel of this near flank fills the LEFT half of frame, its twelve spokes at rest, a chip in its iron tyre standing at the very top of the rim. The camera tracks beside the hansom at the horse's trot for the whole shot as the wheel turns through full revolutions and the cobbles and shopfronts stream past behind it, from 00:04 to 00:06. At 00:06 the hooves strike and spray flies at every stride, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot.

overall_soundscape: The ambience of a black two-wheeled hansom cab runs under the whole take: its own air, the surfaces underfoot and the fabric of the room around it. Cloth, boots, wood and glass carry the physical action, and the movement and low murmur of the people at work nearby carry under it throughout.
